output.summary: Across Guildford and Waverley, 92 supplier pairs share identical names after normalisation. A further 110 candidate pairs have similar names and await a human decision before being called the same supplier; the match judge model has reviewed 12 of these and suggests 4 are the same organisation and 8 are different, but these remain suggestions awaiting a human decision and do not count as shared. Combined spend on the 92 shared pairs totals GBP 14,971,881. The top shared suppliers are Surrey County Council (GBP 4,435,329 combined), PiLON Limited (GBP 1,362,420 combined), Zurich Insurance (GBP 1,197,787 combined), Thames Water Utilities (GBP 655,874 combined) and Vivid Resourcing (GBP 547,630 combined).
recommendations: Confirm or split the 3 most likely pairs first (match judge suggestion, then size): 'South West Surrey Domestic Abuse Outreach Service' (Guildford) vs 'South West Surrey Domestic Abuse Services' (Waverley) - combined GBP 53,774, similarity 0.8889, judge suggests SAME; 'Brodie Plant Goddard' (Guildford) vs 'BPG (Brodie Plant Goddard)' (Waverley) - combined GBP 11,307, similarity 0.9091, judge suggests SAME; 'Thames Water Utilities Ltd (Swindon)' (Guildford) vs 'Thames Water  Utilities Ltd' (Waverley) - combined GBP 11,207, similarity 0.8462, judge suggests SAME

Start supplier consolidation with the largest shared commercial suppliers (public bodies excluded): PiLON Limited (GBP 1,362,420); Zurich Insurance Plc (GBP 1,197,787); Thames Water Utilities Ltd (GBP 655,874); Vivid Resourcing Limited (GBP 547,630); The Oyster Partnership Ltd (GBP 538,135)
To record a decision: POST /run with input.query = "Confirm that '<name A>' (<council>) is the same supplier as '<name B>' (<council>)" - the Memory agent will apply it to every later answer.

agents.name: Router
agents.role: Classifies a free-text request into a supported flow, extracts councils and parameters, or returns a structured unsupported error

agents.name: Researcher
agents.role: Runs federated SQL against the data layer (Zetaris live, cached council files in sample mode) and returns rows with provenance

agents.name: Resolver
agents.role: Normalises supplier names, scores cross-council matches, applies remembered decisions and Companies House identity; marks what still needs a human

agents.name: Memory
agents.role: Meterless H-MEM: recalls earlier human decisions (supplier matches, approvals) and stores new ones with provenance

agents.name: Critic
agents.role: Validates provenance and thresholds on every result; rejects and returns work that does not clear the bar (one real bounce when needed)

agents.name: Writer
agents.role: Drafts briefings and letters from the evidence table (NVIDIA Nemotron via Meterless Nightshift; deterministic template in sample mode)
